text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
戦禍に苦しむのは、いつだって無辜の民だ。
俺はそれをこの目で見て来た。
text.official_en:
It is innocent people who feel most deeply the
ravages of war. I have seen that.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だから力の限り……理不尽に苦しむ者をなくす。
それが俺の、王としての覚悟だ。
text.official_en:
And it's why, as best I can, I will stop unreasonable
suffering. That is my mission as king.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
補給がすぐに底を突くことはないが、
無尽蔵の猶予があるわけでもない。
text.official_en: Our supplies are ample, but not inexhaustible.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ザンジバル要塞の動向も楽観はできん。
我らが生き残る道は、畢竟、前進のみだ。
text.official_en:
And we cannot rely on Fort Zanbar forever. In the
end, our only chance for survival is to march on.
text.real_en:
And we cannot rely on Zanzibar Fortress forever. In the
end, our only chance for survival is to march on.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……おじいさまがアラゴの軍師だった影響で、
あたしの持っている知識もあの国のものが多いわ。
text.official_en:
Since my grandfather was a strategist for Arago, a lot
of what I know is Aragonian.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
間者の疑いをかけられないよう、注意しないと。
諍いを生みたくはないもの。
text.official_en:
I need to be careful that no one suspects me of being
a spy. We don't need any strife like that.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
国をあげた戦いってことで、
騎士の人たちがたくさん出てきてるね。
text.official_en:
It looks like all the nations are getting involved in the
fight. There's tons of knights around.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ぼく、敬礼の仕方とか
まだよくわかんないんだよね。うーん……
text.official_en:
I'm not too sure what kind of salute I should be
giving anybody though. Hmm...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
帝国がこの地を統治してこられたのは、
やっぱり信仰のおかげだけではないのね……
text.official_en:
The empire used more tools than simple faith to
maintain control...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
神殿の有する軍事力、城壁や水道橋を築く技術、
そして神々が持つ圧倒的な権能……
text.official_en:
The strength of their fortifications, the military might
of the temples, the power of the gods themselves...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
こうして戦ってみるまで、実感がなかったけれど……
なんて強大なのかしら……
text.official_en:
Now that we're fighting them, I realize I've never
fully understood their true strength.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
まったく戦争というヤツは、
人の本性を暴き出すものだよねえ。
text.official_en:
If war's good for anything, it's bringing out people's
true natures.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……昔から変わらない光景さ。
こういうものには道化でも辟易とするよ。
text.official_en: Same old scene, again and again. Even I'm sick of it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
でも、もしもそれが
変わることがあるとすれば、それは……
text.official_en: Wonder if there's some way to change it.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゴライアス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
俺っち感動しちまった。兄貴が、
ブレザラントの軍隊をビシッと指揮してよお……
text.official_en:
I got teary-eyed seeing Brezarant's army charge
into battle behind their king.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゴライアス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
剣闘士から将軍に返り咲くどころか、
王様になっちまうなんて……
text.official_en: From a general to a gladiator to a king...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゴライアス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
くうぅぅ……やっぱ兄貴はすげえぜ！！
もちろん、今までも最高だったけどな！
text.official_en:
WAAAH! My brother's the best, and always
has been!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゲイツ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ふ……我らが王は、緒戦から
とんでもない約束を取りつけてくれたものだ……
text.official_en:
Hmm. The war has begun, and our king has made
what may prove to be a dangerous alliance.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゲイツ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だが……やはり気持ちが良い。
曇りなき清廉さで、真っ直ぐに進む姿が。
text.official_en:
Still, I see only a leader moving straight forward with
his integrity unclouded.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ゲイツ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: 私の見立てに間違いはなかったと、改めて思う。
text.official_en: Which means I was correct in my estimation.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
クリュテイオス平原での戦いに、
ブレザラントとサラミスの同盟、王と王の問答……！
text.official_en:
The battle at the Klytius plains, a dialogue between
monarchs, the formation of a new alliance...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
必ず後世に語り継がれるであろう劇的な出来事の
数々を、この目に焼きつけられるとは！
text.official_en:
I never thought I would pay witness to events of such
historic importance!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
これこそぼくの求めていたものだ！
やはりついてきて良かったよ！
text.official_en:
It's all even more fascinating than I'd hoped.
Thank the gods I came along!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
獣が人を模倣し、政治の真似事をし、
そして醜く争い始めた……
text.official_en:
The beasts are at it again—playing their games of
state and starting a war.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
と、以前の私なら、ただただ不快になり、
傍観することすら拒んでいたでしょう。
text.official_en:
In the past I would have watched from the sidelines,
filled with grim displeasure.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
今は多少なりとも力添えをしますよ。
感謝してもらいたいものです。
text.official_en:
Yet now I come to your aid and intervene directly.
You should thank me.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……兵士に『君の力は素晴らしい！』って
褒められたんだけどさ。
text.official_en:
The other day a soldier said to me, "You're so strong!"
Feels strange.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
戦争に役立つことで評価されても複雑だよ。
正直あんまり嬉しく思えなかった。
text.official_en:
I don't know that I want to be recognized for my skill
during a war. I don't like it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
やっぱり、あたいの力は海に使いたいね。
漁なら何の気兼ねもなくできるからさ。
text.official_en:
Really, I want to use my strength on the seas.
Nothing wrong with being strong at fishing.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
私は国や神のために戦う兵士に、
あまりいい思い出がありませんでした。
text.official_en:
Pious soldiers always make me uncomfortable. I've
had more than a few poor experiences with them...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
しかし、間近で見ていると、
自分も彼らも同じ人間なのだと感じます。
text.official_en:
But I know in my gut that, deep down, they're
regular people, just like me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……「私は獣にはならない」。
そう思いたいだけなのかもしれませんが……
text.official_en:
Perhaps they are also thinking they don't wish to
become a beast.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
先祖や国のために戦う連中は大変だな。
死んでも構わないって気迫がびりびり来るぜ。
text.official_en:
It must be a lot of pressure, fighting with the weight
of your ancestors behind you...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……正直おれにはわからんね。
死んだらそれはもう負けだぜ。
text.official_en:
Can't relate. Dying for family, or gods, or whatever,
doesn't matter. Once you die, you've already lost.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シモン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
当然おれはこの戦争も勝たせてもらう。
次の戦場に行くためにな。
text.official_en:
So I'll win this war. And when I'm done here, I'll
move on to the next, then the next...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ルルディヤー
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
武器を仕入れる時に『戦争は金になる』とか
喜ぶ商人がいるけど、あれは良くないと思うな。
text.official_en:
Merchants who say things like "war is money" give
the rest of us a bad name.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ルルディヤー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
商売は他者がいて初めて成立するんだもの。
他人の死を軽んじるのは良くないわ。
text.official_en:
Good business is about unity, really. We shouldn't
relish in pain just because it's easy coin!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ルルディヤー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
尊大さの化身みたいなタリムーンさんだって
相手のことはちゃんと見てたし。
text.official_en:
I'm glad selling death as a way to get rich isn't the
trading company's attitude.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
兵士の方たちの傷を癒やす度に、
お礼を言っていただけるのですが……
text.official_en: Every time I heal a soldier's wounds, they thank me...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
再び戦場に送り出すために、
癒やすことは正しいことなのでしょうか……？
text.official_en:
But is it right to heal their old scars just to send them
back to the battlefield for new ones?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
わかりません……ですが負けを許されぬ戦い。
私はできることをします。
text.official_en:
I don't know... But either way, we can't afford to lose.
If healing's all I can do, so be it.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディエゴ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
陰から少し探ってみたが……
改めて、砦の守りの堅牢さがわかっただけだ。
text.official_en:
I surveyed the situation from hiding. I confirmed
that the fort's defenses are as strong as we thought.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディエゴ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……結局は、ぶつかるしかない。
どんな敵が待ち受けていようとな……
text.official_en:
In the end, we'll need to face the enemy head-on.
No matter what our foes throw at us.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ロレッタ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
この戦争に負けたら、ブレザラント王国は
多分めちゃくちゃにされる。
text.official_en:
If we lose this war, I'd guess that Brezarant will get
really messed up.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ロレッタ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そうなりゃ、クレール神殿や
ゾニさんたちも危ねえってことだ。
text.official_en:
And if that happens...Credna's temple is done
for. And Ozin with it!
text.real_en:
And if that happens...Claire's temple is done
for. And Zoni-san with it!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ロレッタ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
絶対、絶対阻止してみせる。
武器を扱う訓練、してきて良かったぜ。
text.official_en:
I've gotta do what I can to stop all this. Good thing
I'm trained up in how to use weapons.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
よそ者だからと遠慮せず、
私のことは存分に使ってもらって構わない。
text.official_en:
You can rely on me to the fullest. I may be an
outsider here, but I welcome being of use.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そのような気遣いを不要とするほどには、
戦の心得が身についているからな。
text.official_en:
I mastered the art of war long ago. Have no fear.
I can be useful in ways you wouldn't imagine.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ニネ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
大地に広がる戦火に、精霊たちが怯えているわ。
ニネも、なんだか落ち着かない……
text.official_en:
The spirits are scared... The flames of war are
breaking out across the land. I am also uneasy...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ニネ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あるいは、何かを伝えようとしている？
決して止まらない渦のただ中へ、ニネたちは……
text.official_en:
Or is it that the spirits are trying to tell me...that
we're being drawn into a vortex of no escape...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
此度の戦い……
兵らの状態が気になるところだな……
text.official_en: I am concerned about the morale of our soldiers.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ブレザラント軍の合流で勢いづいたものの、
備蓄が減ってゆけばいずれ焦燥が蔓延する。
text.official_en:
The arrival of the Brezarant reinforcements cheered
them, but if our supplies dwindle, the mood will shift.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
陣中で反乱でも起ころうものなら、同盟は内から
瓦解するであろう……それだけは避けなければ。
text.official_en:
If they began to rebel, our alliance would crumble
from within. We must take pains to avoid this.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
会戦の次は、砦攻めだー！　いや、関所破りかー？
まあ、何だろうとやることは同じよ！
text.official_en:
From fightin' in the open to taking a stronghold, no
matter what the objective is, our job is the same.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
グラーニャ戦役の時みたいに、
ワシがドカンと一発、守勢をぶち抜いてやるわい！
text.official_en:
Just like the War of Grania, I'll smash through their
defenses with one blow!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
見れば見るほどヤバそーな気しかしないなー、
アグリス関……これはお手当弾んでもらわなきゃー。
text.official_en:
The more I think about Agris Stronghold, the worse
it seems. I'm gonna need a serious raise for this.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
生き残れなきゃ意味ないケド。
とりあえず勝つコト考えよーっと。
text.official_en:
Though money won't do me any good if I don't make
it out alive. Victory first, cash later.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ライサンダー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ブレザラント王国の騎士たちと
多く交流が持てたのは重畳だな。
text.official_en:
It's been gratifying to interact so freely with the
knights of Brezarant.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ライサンダー
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
彼らの政治への意識も参考になる。
伯父にも報告しておくとしよう。
text.official_en:
I find their political insights well considered. I'll need
to report them back to my uncle.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
軍の士気がここまで高いとは、驚きました。
セオドラ陛下の求心力は凄まじいものがありますな。
text.official_en:

いいえ、それは駄目ね。
ジュラ様の立場が危うくなってしまうもの。
text.official_en:
No, that won't do. That'd put Jurah herself into a
dangerous position.

text.jp:
神威大帝を討つこと自体、あの方への裏切り。
これ以上迷惑はかけられません。
text.official_en:
And I wouldn't dare ask her myself. I've betrayed
the Divine Emperor. I can't bring her more trouble.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン

text.jp:
サラミスとブレザラント、
両軍が連合し、帝国への反撃に成功した……
text.official_en:
Saramis and Brezarant have won their first victory
against the empire.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
戦いは、更にその規模と激しさを
増していくことだろう。
text.official_en:
That victory will be fleeting. Now the true struggle
will begin.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
民を想うアウロラ様のためにも、
無為に戦火が広がらぬことを祈るばかりだ……
text.official_en:
Aurora cares so for the people of these nations. 
I pray the fires of war don't spread far.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ダナン海の海賊は
ダマスカル王国の末裔も多いんだよな……
text.official_en:
Many pirates on the Danann Sea are descendants
of the kingdom of Damascar.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キロイカ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ダグザ様のせいで同じような連中が
また増えるかもしれねえな。
text.official_en:
Now, Dagda's latest outburst could scare up even
more people like that.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キロイカ

text.jp:
俺がまだ“黒鳥海賊団”を率いていたら
行き場のねえ奴も仲間に入れてやれたんだが……
text.official_en:
If I was still leading the Black-Swan Pirates, I'd
recruit any folks with nowhere to go!
text.real_en:
If I was still leading the Blackbird Pirates, I'd
recruit any folks with nowhere to go!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌッツォ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
帝国兵に、ブレザラント兵……サラミス兵ですら、
ハル・ハリ族に好奇と怯えを見せる者がいる。
text.official_en:
Some soldiers of the empire, Brezarant, and even
Saramis show curiosity and fear toward the Har Hali.
text.real_en:
Some soldiers of the empire, Brezarant, and even
Saramis show curiosity and fear toward the Har-Hari.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌッツォ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だがその程度で誇りは傷つかぬ。
味方から奇異の目で見られようと構いはしない。
text.official_en:
But we are no less proud for it. We've never minded
being the object of strange looks from our allies.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌッツォ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そして敵がわれを畏れるなら、
それを利用するまでだ……
text.official_en:
And if our enemies fear us, then we will take full
advantage of their terror.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
騎行の中止命令が下り、
少し安心してしまった自分がいます……
text.official_en:
Honestly, part of me was relieved when they recalled
those of us in the cavalry.

text.jp:
泣きわめき、抵抗する民から、無理やり奪うのは
気持ちの良いものでは、ありませんから……
text.official_en:
It doesn't feel good to confiscate everything from
ordinary people as they wail in despair.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ベルトラン王……
あの男は現実を知らなさすぎる。
text.official_en:
I am afraid the king may be about to learn a lesson
in the way of the world.

text.jp:
黙って待っていても、こちらが滅ぼされるだけだ。
かつてのダマスカル王国と同じように……
text.official_en:
Playing the waiting game will end in our deaths.
What happened at Damascar proved that.

text.jp:
略奪は、そんな我々が帝国に抗うため、
軍団を維持するために必要なことの筈だ。
text.official_en:
Pillaging is something people in our situation have to
do to maintain an army capable of resisting.

text.jp:
セオドラ陛下の命令とあらば従うが……
そんな甘さを持って、生き抜けるものだろうかね。
text.official_en:
If Her Majesty orders it, I'll go along with it. But how
long will we last clinging to these naïve ideas?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
神を敵に回したからなんだ！
俺たちは、異民族相手にだって勝利してきたんだ！
text.official_en:
We have made enemies of the gods. But we're no
stranger to victory against daunting odds.

text.jp:
奴らは人間だが、得体が知れんという意味では、
神も似たようなものだろう！？
text.official_en:
True, our usual foes are human, but their ways are so
unlike ours that they may as well be gods.

text.jp:
だから怖がる必要なんてないのだ！
そうだ、そうに決まっている……！
text.official_en:
So there's no need to be afraid of the coming battle.
If I think of it that way, maybe I can pull through.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
勇ましく戦ってこそ、ブレザラントの兵士。
怯えも戸惑いも、戦場には不要です。
text.official_en:
Bravery is the hallmark of a Brezarant soldier.
Cowardice and hesitation have no place in combat.

text.jp:
感情を戦いに持ち込めば、
隙が生まれ、自らの死を招くだけですから。
text.official_en:
Emotion is the enemy of technique. To show fear on
the battlefield is to invite your own death.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ここがサラミスの本陣か……
死神を崇拝するダマスカル人の末裔の……
text.official_en:
This is the Saraminian headquarters, where the
death-worshipping children of Damascar camp...

text.jp:
味方として戦う以上、文句は言えないが、
やっぱりちょっと不気味なんだよな。うう……
text.official_en:
I've had no complaints about them as comrades.
I just find them kind of creepy.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
新兵老兵問わず、ベルトラン王を慕う者は多い。
軍全体の士気が高く何よりなことだ。
text.official_en:
Morale is higher than ever. From new recruits to
veterans, the army adores their king.

text.jp:
今の状態が維持されれば、逃亡兵も出ないだろう。
味方を処罰するなどは正直御免だからな。
text.official_en:
If the sentiment holds, we might not even have any
deserters. I hate having to punish people on my side.
